name: CN_TP_EVENT_LOGS_ALL_INT
description:
The table stores the information of the events during the deployer process run.
The row can contain the plan object event or a payment object event  or a role compensation plan assignment row event.
The table aslo stores events that affect multiple compensation plans as seperate rows. Earlier this data was constructed and stored in cn_temp_gt table.
This table stores this information to make deployer process resilient.

columns.name: EVENT_LOG_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Used as Unique Identifier for the table.

columns.name: EVENT_LOG_ID
columns.description: Event information copied from cn_tp_event_logs_all table.

columns.name: PRIMARY_OBJECT_ID
columns.description:
Object here can be a compensation plan or a payment object or a compensation role assignment object copied from cn_tp_event_logs_all table.
For the denormalized compensation plans records, -1000 will be populated.
It will be populated as -2000 for denormalized rows of event type NOTIFY

columns.name: SECONDARY_OBJECT_ID
columns.description:
Secondary object id will contain Compensation Plan Id for the plan related compenstion plan events create as part of  denormalization of the plan object event affecting multiple plans
Secondary object id will contain Role Id for Role compensation Plan event.
For the all other events and direct event from logs table -1000 will be populated.
It will be populated as -2000 for denormalized rows of event type NOTIFY

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description:
Will represent whether a Plan object event or a Role compensation plan assignment event or a payment event . A different event type namely,plan event related compenstion plan is used to identify denormalized rows of the plan object event affecting multiple plans.
An event type namely Notify is used to identify the denormalized participant information affected by the event.

columns.name: EVENT_NAME
columns.description: Event name will be taken from the cn_tp_event_logs_all table. Will be null for denormalized event cp association.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: DEPLOY_STATUS
columns.description:
Column used to mark if a event is already processed by deployer in its run to populate the srp tables or payment tables.
It will be populated as null for denormalized rows of event type NOTIFY

columns.name: NOTIFY_LOG_STATUS
columns.description:
Column used to mark if a event is already processed by notify_log process of the deployer.
It will be populated as INCOMPLETE for denormalized rows of event type NOTIFY

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: The column will store the puid value of the object the event represents.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Worker Number that will process this row. This worker number will belong between a range depending on the organization.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Participant for whom notify logs needs to be populated. Will be only populated for event type as NOTIFY

columns.name: PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Period for which the event is logged. Will be only populated for event type as NOTIFY

columns.name: REVERT_STATE
columns.description: Revert State of the event. Will be only populated for event type as NOTIFY possible values are ROLLUP,CALCULATION and ELIGIBLE

columns.name: SRP_COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Points to cn_srp_comp_plans_all. Will be only populated for event type as NOTIFY and REVERT TYPE as ELIGIBLE.

columns.name: PLAN_COMPONENT_ID
columns.description: Points to cn_plan_components_all .Will be only populated for event type as NOTIFY and REVERT TYPE as ELIGIBLE.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Period start date. Will be only populated for event type as NOTIFY

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Period end date. Will be only populated for event type as NOTIFY.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Batch Identifier. Will be only populated for event type as NOTIFY.

columns.name: ERROR_REASON
columns.description: The column will display the reason  the event failed while processing.
